time_domain: tc>t2; no abs/clamp; explicit per-call propagation

arms.pipeline: one frozen P-LNN candidate + independent TRF

common_fit.price: log adjusted close; original observations for refinement
common_fit.linear_solve: four coefficient least squares recomputed each theta
common_fit.qualification: pinned future_fullcycles_1p5_v1; no added R2 rule
common_fit.representative: minimum numerical-valid SSE before structural qualification

sampling.phase_B_choice: largest template fitting 80% wall and CPU budget using A timing only, before B effects; otherwise NOT_RUN
sampling.phase_B_window_selection: four pinned scale groups: first/lower-median/last in each; mismatch blocks run
sampling.phase_B_block_selection: min SHA256('20261116|symbol|start_session') over preregistered eligible development blocks; no outcome-based selection
sampling.right_label_context: through frozen maturity horizon; no new tail predictions
sampling.left_censoring: require complete H=63 history and resolved episode state or report LEFT_CENSORED
sampling.stage_event_cohort: peak in [first_scored_asof,last_scored_asof], common mature event set with complete H prior opportunity; solver failures do not remove events
sampling.claim_matching: full warmup+scoring ledger before cohort filtering; preserve T02 unknown/pending and duplicate rules
sampling.bootstrap: disabled for superiority inference in 1-2 blocks; events<30 => INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE; 30 not sufficient power guarantee

budgets.limit_action: append checkpoint; unfinished pending; cumulative across resumes

matching: pinned T02 earliest formal claim; revisions do not repair; all mature eligible events kept
s10: compatibility appendix only; never substitute for formal interval score

evidence_modes.action_time: same frozen latency and cutoff mapping; late computations shift action time

unresolved_before_execution: A resource isolation and B per-window equal-time cutoff
budget failure tolerance and expand recommendation criterion
initial episode state and full H=63 action opportunities including next-session off-by-one; if unproven NOT_RUN_INITIAL_STATE, no hidden cold reset
actual P checkpoint artifact and permission; source review complete but checkpoint remains unavailable

clustering.expected_windows: independent calendar/history eligibility intersect fixed 12, never derive from successful fits
clustering.qualified_predicate: explicit pinned future_fullcycles_1p5_v1; never default prepare predicate
clustering.date_conversion: floor(lo), ceil(hi) relative to asof; then T02 gate; never narrow interval

precision.resolved_claim_precision: pinned T02 union: action within scored block OR target event in E; resolved first formal claims only
precision.precision_action_cohort: action within scored block; resolved first formal claims, retaining no-event/duplicate penalties, target may be outside E

matched_notification_diagnostic: same opportunity dates every fifth scored asof and at most one formal claim per opportunity; same ledger and current-only information; report underfill, never force equal actual counts with future top-K

phase_A_execution.P_no_weight_action: record NOT_RUN; no random network, no demo or automatic training
phase_A_execution.result_cache: only identical task identities; cache retrieval never solver timing

requires: cost and fit-quality review with documented rationale
A_DECISION.json and separate preregistered B enablement change before outcomes

all_required: source identity and immutable code commit
output order and fixed label scale
training distribution and model selection provenance
restricted load and finite output fixtures

handoff.scope: preflight plus bounded Phase A only
handoff.dispatch_evidence: PR task documents and conversation handoff; external session start NOT_ESTABLISHED

phase_specific_gate: Resolve each arm/phase requirements before that work; B-only unresolved values do not block A, P-only unavailable checkpoint does not block correctly frozen D/G partial baseline
